title: SurfLayers
description: Compute intermediate equi-distant surfaces between two boundary surfaces.

spec_dset.description: Dataset that is the SUMA specification file describing input surfaces
spec_dset.title: Specification dataset

states.description: Typically smoothwm, pial states to describe inner and outer surfaces (default: 'smoothwm pial')
states.title: States

n_intermed_surfs.description: Total number of intermediate surfaces to create
n_intermed_surfs.title: Number of intermediate surfaces

surf_a.description: Inner boundary surface by filename (e.g., smoothwm.gii)
surf_a.title: Inner boundary surface

surf_b.description: Outer boundary surface by filename (e.g., pial.gii)
surf_b.title: Outer boundary surface

no_clean.description: Do not remove temp files (probably just for testing)
no_clean.title: No clean flag
